parameters.name: chop
parameters.label: CHOP
parameters.description: The CHOP to convert to POP attributes.

parameters.name: surftype
parameters.label: Connectivity
parameters.description: Primitive type for connecting points: None, Point Primitives, Line Strip, or Lines.

parameters.name: overridenumpoints
parameters.label: Override Number of Points
parameters.description: Override the number of points produced instead of matching CHOP sample count.

parameters.name: numpoints
parameters.label: Number of Points
parameters.description: Number of points when override is enabled.

parameters.name: interpolate
parameters.label: Interpolate
parameters.description: Interpolate between CHOP samples when point count differs from sample count.

parameters.name: specifypos
parameters.label: Specify Position
parameters.description: Map CHOP samples to a position range using Start/End Position.

parameters.name: startposx
parameters.label: Start Position X
parameters.description: X start of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: startposy
parameters.label: Start Position Y
parameters.description: Y start of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: startposz
parameters.label: Start Position Z
parameters.description: Z start of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: endposx
parameters.label: End Position X
parameters.description: X end of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: endposy
parameters.label: End Position Y
parameters.description: Y end of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: endposz
parameters.label: End Position Z
parameters.description: Z end of position range for mapped points.

parameters.name: closed
parameters.label: Closed
parameters.description: Connect last vertex back to first vertex (for line strip).

parameters.name: chanssel
parameters.label: Channels Selection
parameters.description: How to map channels to attributes: Manual (Specify), Autoconvert with type suffix, or Autoconvert.

parameters.name: chanscope
parameters.label: Channel Scope
parameters.description: Pattern of CHOP channels to convert to point values.

parameters.name: delinputattrs
parameters.label: Delete Input Attributes
parameters.description: Only output which attributes you specify — helps isolate attributes into a separate branch.

useCases: Audio spectrum visualization (FFT bands → point positions and color)
Motion capture data → animated point cloud for body tracking
CHOP-driven LED arrays (channels → point attributes → DMX Out)
Procedural animation (noise CHOP → point displacement on GPU)

examples.name: Audio Spectrum Bars
examples.description: Audio CHOP → Analyze CHOP → CHOP to POP (Specify Position, Y-axis) → Point Sprite MAT

examples.name: Motion Capture Points
examples.description: CHOP channels (X/Y/Z per joint) → CHOP to POP (P attribute) → Noise POP → Render

examples.name: LED Array
examples.description: CHOP channels → CHOP to POP (None connectivity) → Attribute POP (Cd color) → DMX Out POP

commonCombinations: Audio CHOP → CHOP to POP → Attribute POP (color by amplitude)
CHOP to POP → Noise POP (displacement from channel data)
CHOP to POP → GLSL POP (custom vertex shaders driven by CHOP)
CHOP to POP → Render TOP (point sprite rendering of channel data)

troubleshooting.solution: Verify CHOP has data. Check Channel Scope pattern matches your channel names.
Enable Specify Position and set Start/End Position XYZ to map sample values to spatial range.
Check Channels Selection mode — Autoconvert requires Precise naming convention (e.g., Tex_0, Tex_1, Tex_2).
Use type suffix in channel name: f (float), i (int), u (unsigned), F (double).
Disable Interpolate if you want nearest-sample behavior instead of smooth interpolation.

description: Converts CHOP channels to POP point attributes. Each CHOP sample becomes one POP point. Supports automatic channel-to-attribute mapping via naming conventions (compatible with POP to CHOP Precise format). Enables audio visualization, motion capture, and sensor data to flow into the POP pipeline.
